timeline: OUTPUT seconds after EDL cuts at 1.05x (same clock as 05_visual_plan). Word t = glossary-corrected words aligned char-proportionally onto ASR word starts (accuracy ~+-0.1 s) -> re-check against rendered VO; spoken_t kept per word.
safe_zone: all text inside x 90-990 (x<=900 when y>900, TikTok rail) and y 285-1540 (4:5 crop top + TikTok bottom 380 px; YT/IG 320 px implied)

fonts.note: Bangla never italic (synthetic oblique breaks matras/conjuncts); Anton has NO Bengali glyphs - never set a Bangla word in Anton

colours.accent: #E10600 - max one accent word per line; new/after/positive features

rules_applied: word appears at spoken time; clamped up to ~2 frames early only where the 0.35 s pre-cut rule required it (see log)
every unit clears on shot change; only exception C01 holds across the 01->02 whip (same laptop, screen swap)
last word >=0.35 s before every cut
no per-letter typing: 0.032 s/char does not fit 0.6-1.0 s shots -> word-level pops

units.note: H2 lockup part 1 holds through the whip (same laptop, screen swap) - deliberate exception to clear-on-cut
